lanes.summary: I have reviewed the diff against the receipt and all acceptance criteria for PMAT-3183. The implementation cleanly covers the requirements, correctly guarding against absent, incomplete, and falsely-cited changelog entries, with robust test automation included. I could not refute any of the claims.

findings.claim: AC 1: `check_changelog_covers_merged.sh` implemented and correctly identifies uncited PRs using both PR number and PR issue reference.
AC 2: False row detection correctly identifies if a cited PR's merge commit was already an ancestor of LAST_TAG.
AC 3: `--notes` parameter applies the same coverage predicate to an entire release notes file.
AC 4: Self-test table covers all required cases (covered, deleted row, uncited PR, false row, absent section, bare heading) and is wired to `make tier3`.

AC 5: `dogfood.sh` delegates to the coverage guard. FAILS when exit code > 0 unless PHASE is full (which WARNs with count). Fallback logic accurately defaults to heading search if no guard or last tag exists.

lanes.summary: The diff implements PMAT-3183 completely and faithfully without refutation. All 6 acceptance criteria are met: (1) scripts/check_changelog_covers_merged.sh implements the bidirectional coverage predicate over git log --first-parent LAST_TAG..CUT for PR merges ending in (#PR) and issue references (#N) in the subject, exiting 1 on missing coverage; (2) it detects and exits 1 on FALSE-ROW citations of PRs that shipped in ancestors of LAST_TAG; (3) --notes FILE applies the coverage predicate to release notes; (4) a 6-row self-test table tests valid coverage, deleted rows, uncited PRs, false rows, missing sections, and bare headings, and is wired into Makefile tier3; (5) scripts/dogfood.sh calls the guard, failing on pre/post-publish and warning with row count on full runs, with robust tag fallback and heading fallback only when tags or guard are missing; (6) self-test mutants for false-row and covered=1 turn RED as designed. No gates are weakened and no extraneous changes were introduced.

The diff for PMAT-3183 (#3183) fulfills all ticket requirements and acceptance criteria without weakening any gates or introducing out-of-scope changes:
1. `scripts/check_changelog_covers_merged.sh` correctly implements the bidirectional predicate over `git log --first-parent LAST_TAG..CUT` to detect MISSING merged PRs and FALSE-ROW previously-shipped PRs, supports `--notes`, and provides a robust 6-case `--self-test` matching exit codes and error reasons.
2. `scripts/dogfood.sh` row 3 is updated to call `check_changelog_covers_merged.sh`, failing in `pre-publish`/`post-publish` phases and warning with missing row counts in `full` mode, with fallback to heading presence if no previous tag or guard is available.
3. `Makefile` wires the `--self-test` into `tier3`.
4. All receipt claims match the diff and roadmap specifications. No refuting findings found.
